newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stock exchange calmer after record run.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stock exchange calmer after record run.

text.p: Trading on the Tallinn stock exchange calmed on Friday after its recent record run with the index falling and trading down to 62.2 million kroons.
The Tallinn stock market index fell 0.49 percent to 195.93.
Turnover for most banks fell away although Hansapank was active on 33.7 million kroons with its share price peaking at 194 kroons but closing at 186 kroons, up 1.5.
Tallinn Pharmaceutical turned over 7.2 million kroons but was unchanged at 137.5 kroons while Saving Bank was down 0.95 kroons at 88.45 kroons on reduced turnover of 6.7 million kroons.
Tallinna Pank also fell, losing 2.55 kroons to close at 69.50 and it turned over 5.8 million kroons.
Forekspank fell to finish the day at 142.75, two kroons down with 5.2 million kroons worth of shares changing hands.
Union Bank was stable with only 2.6 million kroons traded to close 0.15 kroons down at 45.2 kroons
The over-the-counter-market stayed strong with 13 million kroons traded. The Rakvere meat plant was the most active on 6.9 million kroons and it rose by 0.15 kroons to close at 15 kroons.
